from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu
H={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'}
AAs="ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYV"
Mrows="""4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0

0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
B=np.array([[int(x) for x in r.split()] for r in Mrows.strip().split("\n")],float)
IDX={a:i for i,a in enumerate(AAs)}
def smat(s1,s2):
    return B[np.ix_(np.array([IDX.get(c,0) for c in s1]),np.array([IDX.get(c,0) for c in s2]))]
def nw_lin(s1,s2,g=-8.0):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2); S=smat(s1,s2)
    F=np.zeros((n+1,m+1)); F[0,:]=g*np.arange(m+1); F[:,0]=g*np.arange(n+1)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        diag=F[i-1,:-1]+S[i-1]; up=F[i-1,1:]+g
        row=np.empty(m+1); row[0]=F[i,0]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            row[j]=max(diag[j-1],up[j-1],row[j-1]+g)
        F[i]=row
    i,j=n,m; a1=[];a2=[]
    while i>0 and j>0:
        if abs(F[i,j]-(F[i-1,j-1]+S[i-1,j-1]))<1e-6: a1.append(s1[i-1]);a2.append(s2[j-1]);i-=1;j-=1
        elif abs(F[i,j]-(F[i-1,j]+g))<1e-6: a1.append(s1[i-1]);a2.append('-');i-=1
        else: a1.append('-');a2.append(s2[j-1]);j-=1
    while i>0: a1.append(s1[i-1]);a2.append('-');i-=1
    while j>0: a1.append('-');a2.append(s2[j-1]);j-=1
    return "".join(a1[::-1]),"".join(a2[::-1])

ec="".join(requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/P0ABG1.fasta",headers=H,timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:]).strip()
q='(protein_name:"phosphatidate cytidylyltransferase") AND (reviewed:true) AND (taxonomy_id:2)'
fa=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream",params={"format":"fasta","query":q},headers=H,timeout=180).text
orth=[]
for blk in fa.split(">")[1:]:
    ln=blk.split("\n"); acc=ln[0].split("|")[1]; s="".join(ln[1:]).strip()
    if acc!="P0ABG1" and 200<len(s)<400: orth.append((acc,s))
print("reviewed bacterial CdsA orthologs used:",len(orth))

cons=np.zeros(len(ec)); cov=np.zeros(len(ec))
for acc,s in orth:
    a1,a2=nw_lin(ec,s); i=0
    for x,y in zip(a1,a2):
        if x!='-':
            i+=1
            if y!='-':
                cov[i-1]+=1
                if x==y: cons[i-1]+=1
pct=100*cons/len(orth)
SITE=[(165,'D165','D144',1.5),(187,'G187','R166',70.0),(188,'K188','K167',0.8),(235,'D235','D219',1.6),
      (238,'E238','E222',16.7),(242,'K242','K226',1.2),(262,'D262','D246',0.3),(265,'D265','D249',1.8)]
site_idx=[p-1 for p,_,_,_ in SITE]
bg=[i for i in range(len(ec)) if i not in site_idx]
u,pv=mannwhitneyu([pct[i] for i in site_idx],[pct[i] for i in bg],alternative='greater')
print("\nmean conservation: site %.1f%%  background %.1f%%  Mann-Whitney U p=%.2g"%(np.mean(pct[site_idx]),np.mean(pct[bg]),pv))
print(f"\n{'Ec':>6} {'Tm':>6} {'%orthologs identical':>21} {'%WT activity of Tm Ala mutant':>30}")
for p,e,t,act in SITE: print(f"{e:>6} {t:>6} {pct[p-1]:>21.1f} {act:>30.1f}")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4.6))
x=[pct[p-1] for p,_,_,_ in SITE]; y=[a for *_,a in SITE]
ax[0].scatter(x,y,s=80,c=['crimson' if a<5 else ('darkorange' if a<50 else 'steelblue') for *_,a in SITE],zorder=3)
for p,e,t,a in SITE: ax[0].annotate(f"{e} ({t})",(pct[p-1],a),textcoords="offset points",xytext=(6,5),fontsize=8)
ax[0].set_yscale('symlog',linthresh=1); ax[0].set_xlabel("identity to E. coli residue across %d bacterial CdsA orthologs (%%)"%len(orth))
ax[0].set_ylabel("activity of T. maritima Ala mutant (% of wild type)")
ax[0].set_title("Conservation tracks functional requirement",fontsize=10); ax[0].grid(alpha=.3)
ax[1].bar(range(len(ec)),pct,color='lightgrey',width=1.0)
for p,e,t,a in SITE: ax[1].bar([p-1],[pct[p-1]],color='crimson',width=2.0)
ax[1].axhline(np.mean(pct[bg]),ls='--',c='k',lw=1,label="background mean %.1f%%"%np.mean(pct[bg]))
ax[1].set_xlabel("E. coli CdsA residue number"); ax[1].set_ylabel("% orthologs identical")
ax[1].set_title("Mapped active-site positions (crimson) vs whole chain",fontsize=10); ax[1].legend(fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
